Golden Egg Bread
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 5, 2009 - 11:41pm

Ingredients




1 pkt Yeast
3 cups Bread flour
4 tablespoons Sugar
2 Eggs
6 tablespoons Vegetable oil
1 1/2 teaspoons Salt
3/4 cup Warm water

Preparation

1 Place all ingredients in the pan in the order listed, select white bread and press "Start". 2 NOTE: Unless otherwise noted all ingredients should be at room temperature. 3 This can be mixed on manual of the bread machine. 4 After Second kneading, remove dough from machine, divide into to equal portions and place in small loaf pans. Cover and let rise to double, about 45 min to 1 hour. Bake at 350 f. for 35-40 min.
